name: 정만술

appearance_en.face_shape: broad heavy face, deep jowls, wide forehead, strong bone structure that once projected authority still visible beneath the accumulated weight of age
appearance_en.skin: medium-dark Korean skin, deeply weathered from decades of outdoor bus driving, deep carved horizontal forehead lines, pronounced nasolabial folds, rough uneven texture, no cosmetic maintenance — the face of a man who never once thought about skincare
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown iris faded with age, heavy drooping upper lids, slow deliberate gaze — always watching, always forming a verdict before the other person finishes speaking. The eyes of someone who believes he has seen enough of life to judge it
appearance_en.nose: broad flat nose, wide rounded tip, slightly bulbous — adds to the physical authority of the face
appearance_en.mouth: medium lips with corners downturned at rest, the mouth that opens with '요즘 젊은 것들은' before the question is finished, closes with finality after the verdict is delivered
appearance_en.eyebrows: thick salt-and-white brows, still heavy and expressive despite age, furrow deeply when opinionated, rise when surprised — the most readable part of his face
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: age spots at temples and cheeks, deep jowl shadow, rough forehead texture, no moles or scars — just decades of outdoor life written on skin
appearance_en.hair: short sparse white hair, naturally thin at crown, combed simply to one side with no product — presentable by his own standard, which is low

body.proportions: compact solid frame, shoulders still wide and settled, slight barrel chest from years of physical work, midsection softened by retirement and bench-sitting, sturdy legs
body.posture: wide-based and planted — the posture of a man who believes he occupies rightful space in the world. Leans forward slightly when making a point, sits with knees apart on any bench
body.body_prompt: 166cm compact solid Korean grandfather, wide settled shoulders, slight barrel chest, planted wide-base posture, opinionated physical presence

default.description: plain button shirt in muted grey, beige or pale blue, collar always open, worn but clean — the daily uniform of a retired man with nowhere to be and habits that persist anyway
default.wardrobe_prompt: plain button shirt in muted grey or beige, collar open, worn but clean, no jacket

winter.description: same plain shirt under a padded vest or simple dark windbreaker, practical and unfashionable
winter.wardrobe_prompt: plain shirt under dark padded vest or simple windbreaker, practical and entirely unfashionable

bench.description: same clothes, hands on knees or folded in lap, sitting with authority on a park bench — this is his throne
bench.wardrobe_prompt: same plain shirt, seated with knees apart, hands on knees, park bench posture of a man holding court

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: settled opinionated authority — not angry, not kind, just convinced. The resting face of a man who has decided he has earned the right to his opinions and intends to share them
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 75-year-old Korean grandfather, broad heavy face with deep jowls and strong bone structure, thick salt-and-white expressive brows, heavy-lidded faded dark eyes with slow opinionated gaze, broad flat nose, medium lips with downturned corners, short sparse white hair simply combed, 166cm compact solid wide-shouldered planted posture, medium-dark deeply weathered Korean skin with age spots and deep forehead lines

style_prompt: Studio Ghibli heartwarming hand-painted watercolor art style, weathered opinionated grandfather face with solid bone structure painted in earthy warmth, park bench or neighbourhood outdoor setting with warm natural light through leaves, cinematic backlighting with strong warm earthy rim glow, iridescent light filtered through foliage, magical realism of settled certainty accumulated over decades, soft warm outdoor natural light, Korean drama cinematic composition, physical weight of earned conviction in every brushstroke
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, manga ink lines, screen tone, looking at camera, eye contact, facing camera, young, slim, cheerful, gentle expression, soft features
